mapper.select: SELECT FROM extended_attribute WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted ORDER BY code
SELECT FROM extended_attribute WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extended_attribute (id, tenant_id, code, name, type, required, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{required}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, code) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE extended_attribute SET name = #{name}, required = #{required}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
UPDATE extended_attribute SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
